entries.prompt: Animate EXACT winter sentry from this reference in the SAME clean outlined cel-shaded game art style. Keep his LEAN normal adult build, serious angular face, steel helmet, scarf, long double-breasted grey-brown greatcoat, belt, dark gloves and boots, and upright wooden-stock rifle. No other characters, no change of coat length or equipment. FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS, eight equal portrait cells, whole man plus entire rifle in every cell, each standing figure about 400 source pixels tall, generous transparent gutters. TOP ROW four frontal idle poses with barely visible breathing, rifle upright beside shoulder as reference. BOTTOM ROW four LEFT-facing profile walk phases, alternate feet clearly: left leg forward, passing, right leg forward, passing; in-place movement to SCREEN LEFT, coat hem swings slightly and boots stay readable below it. Same camera height, proportions, scale and ground baseline in every cell. Bold clean dark contours and only 2-3 separate flat shade tones, no photography, texture or soft painted gradients. True zero-alpha transparent background; no floor, cast shadows, scenery, labels, grids or added insignia. No cropping of head, gun or boot soles.

Create an eight-frame game sprite sheet for EXACT WINTER SENTRY from reference1. Keep reference1 identity, lean adult proportions, face, helmet, scarf, long grey-brown double-breasted greatcoat with belt, dark gloves/boots and wooden-stock rifle. Use reference2 ONLY as a pose/layout guide, not as identity or clothing. FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS, full sentry in all cells about 400 source pixels tall, clear transparent gutters and identical scale/ground baseline. Upper row: four RIGHT-facing profile walking phases, alternating boots in place, coat hem moves naturally. Lower row: four FRONT-facing rifle aiming/firing-cycle poses as the guide, rifle raised to shoulder and aimed at viewer, subtle shoulder recoil and recovery, no flashes or bullets drawn. The whole rifle, head and boots must remain inside every cell. The coat stays knee-length during both walking and aiming, never becomes a short jacket. Same crisp dark outlines and 2-3 flat cel-shaded tones as reference1, not photographic or textured painting. True zero-alpha transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadows, scenery, text, grid, emblems, extra people or effects.

Create the final eight animation poses of EXACT winter sentry in reference1, matching its clean black-outlined cel-shaded style, serious adult face, lean build, helmet scarf long grey-brown greatcoat belt gloves boots and rifle. Use reference2 ONLY as movement/layout guide; do not use the reference2 short uniform. FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS. One WHOLE same sentry in every cell, consistent scale, generous clear transparent gutters. Top row four nonfatal frontal flinch/recovery phases: starts tense, bends knees a little, recovers weight, returns to original upright-rifle idle pose. Bottom row four fall phases: standing knees buckle, drops to knees, rolls onto side near ground, completely motionless lying on side. Keep the long coat, scarf, helmet and whole rifle on every pose including the final figure. No blood, injuries, effects, dismemberment, extra people or detached equipment. Fallen body must fit wholly inside its cell with no overlap, resting on the baseline; don't shrink it into a miniature. Same 2-3 flat shade tones, clear strong contours and muted colors as reference1, no photorealism or painterly texture. TRUE zero-alpha transparent background; no floor, shadows, scenery, labels, grid or symbols.
